title: Miko <> Kobi: Midway sync - 2026/07/03 11:01 EDT - Notes by Gemini
screen_reason: Internal 1:1 with a WagerTech segment (lines 63-376 and 410): prod purge status, PoC object scope, marketing object exclusion, sign-up LWC stretch goal, Wednesday client meeting plan and Tuesday pencils-down deadline.

items.topic: Production org purged to blank state
items.statement: Production was purged (cleared) by Jester, so the org is in a blank state and the team can start building components.

items.topic: PoC with main objects before Wednesday
items.statement: Jumpr will build a proof of concept (PoC) with the main objects ahead of the Wednesday client meeting. This is an internal Jumpr plan; the client did not take part in this call.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: We're going to do like a PC uh with like the main objects and everything uh / Miko Sumagang: Okay. / Kobi Kunasekaran: for uh like ahead of Wednesday.

items.statement: The PoC core objects are tentatively operator, deal, partner and player, with main fields only, shown in the Lightning console. Kobi said he still has to put the list together, so the object list is not final.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: Uh to a degree I got I got to put put together like a list, / Miko Sumagang: out? / Kobi Kunasekaran: but essentially like the operator, deal vend uh not vendor, partner, uh player, like the core objects minus like the marketing one because we said we're not going to do that one. / [00:01:55] / Miko Sumagang: Okay. / Kobi Kunasekaran: just the main fields and kind of show them what the interface looks like with the lightning console.
items.asr_note: Gemini Details (line 43) lists operator, deal, player; Gemini Next steps (line 34) lists operator, partner, player. The transcript names all four.

items.topic: Marketing object excluded per earlier agreement
items.statement: The marketing object is excluded from the PoC core objects. Kobi cites an earlier agreement not to build that object. The transcript does not make clear if the exclusion is for the PoC only or for the whole project.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: but essentially like the operator, deal vend uh not vendor, partner, uh player, like the core objects minus like the marketing one because we said we're not going to do that one.
items.supersedes_hint: References an earlier decision ('we said we're not going to do that one') not to build the marketing object.

items.statement: An LWC for simplified sign-up logging is a stretch goal for the Wednesday PoC only if time permits; Kobi is unsure it can be built in time without rework later, so it is left open-ended.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: scratch goal is to build the LWC for like the simplified signup logging, / Miko Sumagang: Okay. / Kobi Kunasekaran: but uh I don't know if we'll have enough time to uh like completely like build that out and not like without having to like rework it later.

Doesn't necessarily mean that he has to be like followed, but I think that it will be like a nice buildup, right?

notes: Only WagerTech delivery content recorded. Items 12-15 are about the internal Slack AI agent used to track WagerTech delivery work, not client scope; weight them low for the Jira variance analysis.
